items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and reject the new rodhat.com production change this cycle. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is reported as $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI spend is $886.12 across 4,865 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, including 225 errors. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly limits are blank, and no learning threshold is defined. SEO impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, and shipped-output counts are not financial return. Continue only existing repair-or-close, measurement, attribution reconciliation, and bounded legal/security evidence work.

Handoff: preserve the existing complicated.work readiness assessment and other already-authorized report-only work without creating duplicate finance telemetry. Keep all growth and SEO opportunities deferred until attribution, cost reconciliation, failure repair, and measurement gates clear. Do not move money, change billing, access banking, sign contracts, or make legal or tax determinations.
